name: workbench_service_status
description: Read actual backend health and instance identity. Does not start or stop the service. Uses only this project's credential; never falls back to management access.

name: workbench_read
description: GET a documented local /v1 read route, including workspace/board/history/search/receipts. No arbitrary URLs or lifecycle operations. Uses only this project's credential; never falls back to management access.

name: workbench_publish_project
description: Reliably register/update workspace, artifact, stage, version, feedback, plan, task, record or canvas; verify receipt and exact revision. Pass the unchanged v1 envelope. refresh snapshots selected source files. This is one operation, not an atomic batch. Uses only this project's credential; never falls back to management access.
